newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 1.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Hong Kong returns to mainland China.
President Lee Teng-hui urges communist China to ensure Hong Kong's freedom and democracy.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Hong Kong reverts to Chinese sovereignty.
Chinese troops enter Hong Kong to take over Hong Kong defences.
LIBERTY TIMES - Taiwan rejects "one country, two systems", calling for reunification under "one country, one good system."
Ruling Nationalist and opposition Democratic Progressive parties fail to reach agreement on constitutional reforms.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan needs countermeasures to govern Hong Kong-funded and China-funded investments.
Premier Lien Chan says Taiwan will allow Taichung and Keelung harbours to become offshore transhipment centres if communist China shows favourable response.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Hong Kong ends 156-year of British colonial rule.
Taiwan to let insurance companies buy Hong Kong stocks.
